# NEW 2026-11-23 v16.0 Module 16.0-D: Byzantine Diocese Katepanate Voluntary Consolidation (oe_kat_, Scheme 3A Phase 2, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v160_katepanate.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope (BYZ). True when BYZ has activated classical Prefectures/Dioceses OR holds >= 6 Themes + 25 Authority.
oe_kat_charter_eligible = {
	tag = BYZ
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		oe_prf_has_active_prefecture = yes
		oe_prf_active_dioceses >= 1
		AND = {
			oe_kat_theme_count >= 6
			oe_prf_auth >= 25
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (BYZ). True when voluntary Diocese Katepanate consolidation may be invoked.
oe_kat_byz_ready = {
	tag = BYZ
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		var:oe_kat_charter_proclaimed ?= 1
		oe_kat_charter_eligible = yes
	}
}

# Theme scope. True when a theme is currently elevated to an active Diocese Katepanate.
oe_kat_is_active_katepanate = {
	oe_theme_member_trigger = yes
	var:oe_kat_is_katepanate ?= 1
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now }
}

# Theme scope. Ordinary non-Naval, non-Hereditary, non-Revolt, non-Katepanate minor theme eligible for absorption.
oe_kat_eligible_absorb_base = {
	oe_theme_convertible_trigger = yes
	has_variable = oe_theme_region_id
	NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_naval }
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_tg_hereditary }
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now }
	NOT = { var:oe_kat_is_katepanate ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region }
	NOT = { oe_ts_despot = yes }
	at_war = no
}

# Theme scope. Loyal ordinary (or co-administering) non-Naval, non-Hereditary, non-Revolt theme eligible to lead a Katepanate.
oe_kat_eligible_lead_base = {
	oe_theme_convertible_trigger = yes
	NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_naval }
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_tg_hereditary }
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now }
	NOT = { oe_ts_despot = yes }
	at_war = no
	OR = {
		var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 2
		var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 3
	}
}

# Theme scope; compares against scope:oe_kat_probe_lead in the same or adjacent distance cluster.
oe_kat_in_probe_cluster = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_distance }
		scope:oe_kat_probe_lead = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_distance } }
		AND = {
			var:oe_theme_distance ?= 1
			scope:oe_kat_probe_lead = { OR = { var:oe_theme_distance ?= 1 var:oe_theme_distance ?= 2 } }
		}
		AND = {
			var:oe_theme_distance ?= 2
			scope:oe_kat_probe_lead = { OR = { var:oe_theme_distance ?= 1 var:oe_theme_distance ?= 2 var:oe_theme_distance ?= 3 } }
		}
		AND = {
			var:oe_theme_distance ?= 3
			scope:oe_kat_probe_lead = { OR = { var:oe_theme_distance ?= 2 var:oe_theme_distance ?= 3 var:oe_theme_distance ?= 4 } }
		}
		AND = {
			var:oe_theme_distance ?= 4
			scope:oe_kat_probe_lead = { OR = { var:oe_theme_distance ?= 3 var:oe_theme_distance ?= 4 } }
		}
	}
}

# Theme scope; compares against scope:oe_kat_lead during execution.
oe_kat_in_lead_cluster = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_distance }
		scope:oe_kat_lead = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_distance } }
		AND = {
			var:oe_theme_distance ?= 1
			scope:oe_kat_lead = { OR = { var:oe_theme_distance ?= 1 var:oe_theme_distance ?= 2 } }
		}
		AND = {
			var:oe_theme_distance ?= 2
			scope:oe_kat_lead = { OR = { var:oe_theme_distance ?= 1 var:oe_theme_distance ?= 2 var:oe_theme_distance ?= 3 } }
		}
		AND = {
			var:oe_theme_distance ?= 3
			scope:oe_kat_lead = { OR = { var:oe_theme_distance ?= 2 var:oe_theme_distance ?= 3 var:oe_theme_distance ?= 4 } }
		}
		AND = {
			var:oe_theme_distance ?= 4
			scope:oe_kat_lead = { OR = { var:oe_theme_distance ?= 3 var:oe_theme_distance ?= 4 } }
		}
	}
}

# Theme scope. Selectable lead theme that either has an eligible cluster partner to absorb or already holds absorbed regions awaiting elevation.
oe_kat_selectable_lead_theme = {
	oe_kat_eligible_lead_base = yes
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region
			NOT = { var:oe_kat_is_katepanate ?= 1 }
		}
		AND = {
			oe_t2_receiver_under_region_cap = yes
			save_temporary_scope_as = oe_kat_probe_lead
			c:BYZ = {
				any_subject = {
					oe_kat_eligible_absorb_base = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:oe_kat_probe_lead }
					oe_kat_in_probe_cluster = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
